lines.text: What strange phenomena occur in the final seconds before the Moon completely swallows the Sun?
As totality approaches, daylight dims into a ghostly, silvery twilight unlike any sunset on Earth.
Surrounding air temperatures drop by ten to fifteen degrees within minutes, kicking up sudden chilly breezes.
Confused crickets start chirping, birds fall silent and roost, and flowers close their petals.
Right along the edge, brilliant pearls of sunlight called Baily's Beads shine through lunar valleys.
Then, totality hits: the Sun's ghostly white corona blooms across a pitch-black midday sky.
Witnessing a total solar eclipse is a moment you will never forget.
